instagram:
Your goosebumps are built for fur you no longer have.

Goosebumps may help animals with thick fur stay warm, but humans do not seem to benefit much from the reaction. Harvard researchers found in mice that the cells behind goosebumps also help regulate the stem cells that regrow hair. Research suggests the reflex stayed because it quietly does a second job.

A leftover reflex that still has work to do.

In 1999, theaters handed out missing person flyers.

At screenings of The Blair Witch Project, the filmmakers handed out missing person flyers for the 3 students in the film and asked audiences for information. The film's website added fake historical documents and news interviews, and those materials are now held by the University of Pittsburgh Library System.

The scare began before the lights went down.

A bonfire was once, quite literally, a bone fire.

Bonfire appears in English in the late 1300s as bonfir or banefire, meaning a fire in which bones are burned. That original sense faded and was forgotten by the 1700s. By the mid 1500s the word already meant a large open air fire for celebration.

The word began as bone plus fire.
